newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Steniel 1996 net loss at 245.6 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Steniel 1996 net loss at 245.6 mln pesos.

text.p: Packaging firm Steniel Manufacturing Corp on Thursday reported a net loss of 245.6 million pesos in 1996.
The company did not give a comparative year-ago figure.

A statement from Steniel said: "The loss resulted principally from adverse conditions in the packaging industry during the year and a restructuring undertaken to return the group to profitability within 1997."
Steniel is a unit of diversified firm Metro Pacific Corp.

Both of Steniel's principal operations, the corrugated carton division and its flexible packaging subsidiary, AR Packaging Corporation (ARPC), faced difficult market conditions during the year resulting in operating losses, the statement said.
